claims.claim: Lysa started with six reeds on the bench in Duskfen.
Gathering reeds takes twenty minutes and yields two reeds.
Weaving one storm mat costs three reeds, takes thirty minutes, and pays eight coins.
A witness knot might restore lost memories, though no procedure is known.
Ferry repair requires three mats but needs separate tools and duration not provided.

draft.siteDescription: A riverside bench where reeds are gathered and woven into storm mats.
draft.activityDescription: Consume reeds to craft a storm mat over thirty minutes.

blockedMechanics: Ferry deck repair requires three mats plus ferryman and tools with no defined duration or cost.
Witness knots are rumored to restore memory but lack any recipe, ingredients, or casting procedure.
The locked stone gate requires saltwater to open, a fact unknown to Lysa and unsupported by mechanics.
reviewed.publicLine: I can gather reeds and weave mats for the ferry, though I do not know how that stone gate opens.
